intro: Taco Palenque is the Texas-born Tex-Mex fast-food chain out of Laredo, known for its authentic South Texas tacos, the signature Pirata taco, mesquite-grilled fajitas, breakfast tacos, burritos and the loaded Panchos nachos. It is a border-style quick-service favorite. Below is the full Taco Palenque menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At Taco Palenque, a signature Pirata taco is about $4.89, fajita tacos run $2.79 to $4.19, and breakfast tacos start at $1.99. Fajita plates are $10.99 to $12.99, burritos $7.49 to $8.49, and loaded Panchos nachos $7.49 to $9.90. The Pirata taco and the mesquite fajitas are the signatures. Prices vary by location.
hot_deal: Taco Palenque value: breakfast tacos (from $1.99) and the beans taco ($1.09) are the cheapest bites, and the Duo Plate ($5.99) is a cheap full meal. The crispy chicken fajita taco ($2.79) is the value fajita. Taco Palenque runs frequent combo and app deals. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: What is a Pirata taco at Taco Palenque?
faqs.a: The Pirata is Taco Palenque's signature taco: fajita meat with beans and cheese on a grilled flour tortilla. It is about $4.89 and the dish the chain is best known for. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much are fajitas at Taco Palenque?
faqs.a: Fajita tacos run about $2.79 for crispy chicken, $3.79 for chicken breast and $4.19 for beef. Full fajita plates with rice, beans and tortillas are $10.99 for chicken and $12.99 for beef. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: What is Taco Palenque known for?
faqs.a: Taco Palenque is a Texas-born Tex-Mex fast-food chain from Laredo, known for authentic South Texas tacos, the signature Pirata taco, mesquite-grilled fajitas, breakfast tacos and the loaded Panchos nachos. It is a border-style quick-service favorite.

Yes. Taco Palenque serves breakfast tacos (potato and egg, bacon and egg, chorizo, barbacoa and more) starting around $1.99, plus breakfast chilaquiles. Breakfast tacos are one of the cheapest and most popular orders.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Taco Palenque?
faqs.a: Favorites include the Pirata taco, the beef fajitas plate, the Panchos nachos, the breakfast tacos, and the al pastor tacos.
